scope: Social Create Hub to Composer flow

changes.summary: Composer now receives source metadata from Create Hub: camera, gallery, clip, story or tweet. Tweet / postare opens a text-first Tweet composer instead of a generic post form.
Added composerIntent rail with Tweet, Media and Story options, source-specific guidance, tweet-only 500 character limit, caption counter and premium/text-first/media-first classes.
Removed old in-composer createKinds toggle so the user sees one clear creation architecture instead of duplicated controls.
Added premium composer styling, prismatic intent buttons, text-first tweet textarea, media-first preview sizing and sticky composer actions.
Static audits updated for social38, composerIntent, tweet source, 500 character counter, removed createKinds markup and composer CSS.

npm_test.reason: npm is not available in the current PowerShell PATH

native_picker_safety.reason: Camera/Gallery native pickers can block the test browser on OS permission/file dialogs; routes were verified statically and Create Hub was verified visually.

next: Improve actual publishing feedback: publish should insert the new text post into the visible Tweets feed immediately after success.
Add media-first preview polish for selected gallery video/photo once manual picker interaction is tested by the owner.
Continue toward WhatsApp-grade Messages UI after Social composer is acceptable.
